entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I think I need to return my VeloBand. I'm just so lost with it.
I'm sorry to hear that you're having trouble. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me a bit more? What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, I don't think. It's just... so confusing. I really expected more from it. The menus are hard to use and the pulse readings don't seem right. It's just not what I thought it would be.
Okay, I understand. It sounds like it's not quite the user experience you were hoping for.
Exactly! I even read the user manual, but it didn't help me at all. It just feels overwhelming. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like to send it back if possible.
Of course. Let me just pull up your order information and I'll check on the return eligibility for you. One moment, please.
Alright, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 26 days ago. Let's see... yes, according to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? I thought I might have waited too long! That's wonderful. So I can return it for a refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll see the full refund processed within 5 to 7 business days after we receive it.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie! You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
